01 / THE PROJECT

Car maintenance, made simple

CarUp is a mobile app designed to help drivers manage their car maintenance,
track important dates, and keep everything in one place.

02 / THE PROBLEM

Managing car maintenance can be confusing. Important dates, documents, and payments are often scattered across different places, making it easy to forget what needs to be done.

03 / THE SOLUTION

CarUp brings everything together in one simple app. Users can track their car insurance, annual vehicle inspection, and maintenance, receive timely notifications, and easily access important documents.

04 / THE HOME SCREEN

Designed for simplicity

CarUp brings essential vehicle information into one clear dashboard,
making it easy to see what matters and what needs attention.

05 / SMART REMINDERS

Never miss a date

Smart reminders help drivers stay on top of important deadlines.

06 / HOW IT WORKS

Book your test, stress-free

From finding a nearby inspection center to completing the process.
